subject: Waterway information - Channel Closure - BC Inland Waterways and Lakes - Kamloops
text:
Waterway information - Channel Closure - BC Inland Waterways and Lakes - Kamloops
The Red Bridge in Kamloops has collapsed in the South Thompson River at 50 40.812N 120 19.500W.
The waterway from Pioneer Park and Riverside Park is closed until the debris is cleared.
Caution. 
 
                                                    Cancels NW-P-1531-24
